description: This is a Java test class `ImmutableTopicPathPlaceholderTest` that verifies the immutability, equality, and various placeholder resolution behaviors for the class `ImmutableTopicPathPlaceholder` within the Eclipse Ditto project. It contains unit tests for resolving topic path components such as namespace, entity ID, channel, group, criterion, action, and subject, as well as testing unknown placeholders.

classes.name: ImmutableTopicPathPlaceholderTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing `ImmutableTopicPathPlaceholder`, focusing on immutability, equality, and placeholder resolution behavior.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that instances of `ImmutableTopicPathPlaceholder` are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies correct implementation of `hashCode()` and `equals()` for `ImmutableTopicPathPlaceholder`.

methods.name: testReplaceFull
methods.description: Tests replacement of 'full' placeholder in topic path.

methods.name: testReplaceSubjectEmpty
methods.description: Tests behavior when 'subject' placeholder is empty.

methods.name: testReplaceSubject
methods.description: Tests replacement of 'subject' placeholder with a known subject.

methods.name: testReplaceWeirdSubject
methods.description: Tests replacement of 'subject' placeholder with a complex or unusual subject string.

methods.name: testReplaceActionOrSubject
methods.description: Tests replacement behavior for placeholders that could be 'action' or 'subject'.

methods.name: testReplaceActionOrSubjectWithSubject
methods.description: Tests 'action-subject' placeholder resolution when subject is present.

methods.name: testReplaceActionOrSubjectWithWeirdSubject
methods.description: Tests 'action-subject' placeholder resolution with a complex subject.

methods.name: testUnknownPlaceholderReturnsEmpty
methods.description: Verifies that unknown placeholder identifiers resolve to empty.
